description: Design and size a cable (power, control, LAN, coaxial, fibre) from a sentence (Turkish or English, e.g. "3-core collective screen 12/20 kV 3x95/25 Al, longitudinally watertight") or a spec: every layer's thickness with its source (IEC 60502, HD 603 / 620, BS, EN 50525, NEC / UL and more; IEC 60228), the overall diameter, the designation and the decoder's reading of it, and the estimated weight, bending radius, pulling force, IEC 60757 colours and MV field stress with their sources; current, voltage drop and short-circuit ratings; a bare designation works as the sentence; optional XML, DXF, SVG, CSV, GLB, STEP (3D CAD) and a PDF datasheet. Deterministic, no LLM; a nominal calculation, not a datasheet.

cpc.description: For cpc: {kind armour | core | separate (default the armour where the design has one), basis iec | bs, column tp70 | tp90 | ts90, section_mm2, metal Cu | Al (a separate conductor), system TN | TT, circuit final | distribution, u0_v (line to earth, default 230), ia_a (the current that operates the device in time)}.

design.description: Instead of a sentence: the design field of an earlier answer, changed.

fault.description: For cpc: {ka (the fault current), seconds (default fault_s)}: the adiabatic check of the armour or protective conductor (IEC 60364-5-54:2011 Annex A, BS 7671 Tables 54.2 to 54.4) up to 1 kV.

formats.description: Files to include: xml, dxf, svg, csv, glb (base64), step (STEP AP214 text), pdf (datasheet, base64).

installation.description: For ratings.current: how the cable is installed; the designer's defaults for what is not given (buried 0.8 m, 20 °C ground, 1.5 K·m/W, trefoil, alone). At 0.6/1 kV group, arrangement, clearance, trays and h3_pct give the IEC 60364-5-52 B.52.17 to B.52.21 (BS 7671 4C1 to 4C3) grouping and the E.52.1 harmonic factors. The answer lists the defaults used and the fields the cable's table does not read.

arrangement.description: 0.6/1 kV in air: how the group lies (bunched, on a wall or ceiling, on perforated, vertical or unperforated trays, on ladders, spaced); default bunched.

clearance.description: 0.6/1 kV: touching (default), oneDiameter (multicore cables on an IEC tray), or the clearance in the ground between cables or ducts, m (0.125 to 1.0).

cord_carrying.description: A North American flexible cord (NFPA 79 2024 Table 12.8.2 at 30 °C): 3 current-carrying conductors (column A, default) or 2 (column B); a cord of two conductors is always column B.

h3_pct.description: 0.6/1 kV 4- and 5-core cables: the third-harmonic share of the phase current, % (IEC 60364-5-52 Table E.52.1).

iec_method.description: IEC 60364-5-52 reference method, 0.6/1 kV IEC basis (Table B.52.1): A1 / B1 single-core in conduit, A2 / B2 multicore in conduit, C on a wall, D1 in ducts, D2 direct in the ground, E / F in free air.

is_method.description: IS 694 on IS 3961 (Part 5): clipped (default), enclosed (in conduit or trunking), defined (the defined conditions) or trefoil (single-core, three-phase only).

mv_install.description: Type MV and URD (NFPA 70 2026, 315.60 Tables (C)(1) to (C)(20)): airIsolated, airTriplexed, conduitAir, duct (default), buried or buriedTriplexed; the tables the construction has. group picks the circuits of the table (duct 1, 3 or 6; buried 1 or 2); air_c (default 40) or ground_c (default 20) the ambient.

mv_temp_c.description: Type MV and URD: the 90 °C (MV-90) or 105 °C (MV-105) column; default 90 for URD, 105 for MV-105.

phase.description: IS 694 single-core on IS 3961 (Part 5): a single-phase (2 cables) or three-phase (3 or 4 cables, default) circuit.

protection.description: IS 694 on IS 3961 (Part 5): close (default) or coarse excess current protection, which picks the Table 8 ambient row.

rating_basis.description: An Indian design (IS 1554-1, IS 7098-1, IS 7098-2, IS 694): iec (default, the IEC tables as for any design) or is3961. IS 1554-1 / IS 7098: the IS 3961 Part 2, 6 or 7 tables with their ambient, depth and soil factors (laying, formation, air_c default 40, ground_c default 30, depth_m default the depth of the part, soil_k_m_per_w default 1.5) and their group tables (group: circuits or multicore cables, one alone by default; in the ground or a duct spacing_mm, the clear distance between them, 0 touching, and tiers for multicore cables laid direct, Part 2 / 6 only; in air support tray (perforated), vertical or ladder, trays, and clearance oneDiameter for spaced multicore cables, else touching). IS 694: IS 3961 (Part 5) with is_method, phase (single-core), protection, air_c (default 40) and group (the circuits, cl. 4.2); flexible cables and cords take Table 5 with air_c and group only.

tiers.description: IS 3961 (Part 2 / 6) Table 27 / 21: multicore cables laid direct in the ground in tiers (rating_basis is3961, group above 1).

lang.description: Any of the site's 15 languages for the answer's words (the sentence itself is read in English or Turkish).

load.description: For voltage_drop and sizing: {length_m (required), amps or kw (default the design's own rating), phases 1 | 3, volts, pf (0.85), temp_c (the insulation's normal temperature), hz, limit_pct (a Table G.52.1 row 3, 5, 6, 8 raised beyond 100 m, or an own limit; default 5), conduit pvc | al | steel (NEC wires, Chapter 9 Table 9), formation touching | flat | spaced (single-core cables)}. IEC 60364-5-52 Annex G with the IEC 60287-1-1 a.c. resistance, BS 7671 Tables 4E4B, 4D4B, 4E3B, 4D3B or NEC Chapter 9 Table 9, and the smallest size by current, by drop and by both.

nec.description: North American wires: {ocpd_a (the overcurrent device; default from the ampacity), phase_min (250.122(B): the size before upsizing), install raceway | air, ambient_c, carrying, termination_c 60 | 75 | 90}: nec.ampacity (NEC 310.16) and nec.egc (Table 250.122).

sentence.description: The cable in words, Turkish or English: voltage, cores, section, conductor metal, screen, sheath, watertightness, armour. What is not said takes a default, and the answer lists which.

spec.description: Instead of a sentence: {voltage: "12/20", cores: 3, section: 95, metal, screen, screenType, screenSection, screenLay (helical | interstices), insulation, sheath, watertight, armour}; add standard (an id from design_presets: HD620-10C, BS6724, UL-NMB, EN50525-2-21 ...) for that family's own build at the nearest voltage, size and count it lists.

test_variant.description: For after_installation: a national variant of the tests after installation (HD620-10A, HD620-10C, HD620-10J, HD620-10M, HD620-10R, BS6622, IS1255, BS7846, BS5467, HD603-3F, HD603-G); default the one the design's standard implies.
